detail.title: Your Order
detail.subTitle: Your Purchase Summary
detail.cancelDisclaimer: You can only cancel before the seller prepares the shipment.
detail.trackSub: Track your hardware in real time
detail.trustMsg: Your money is safe. Selene holds it until you confirm the hardware is working perfectly.
detail.cancelledMsg: Order has been canceled. If payment has already been made, the refund will be processed automatically.
detail.disputeMsgBuyer: Your funds are protected by Selene. We are reviewing the case and will issue a verdict within 72 hours.
detail.disputeMsgSeller: Buyer reported an issue. Funds are temporarily frozen while our team reviews the case. We will notify you of any updates.
detail.refundedMsg: The money has been refunded to the buyer.
detail.videoWarningMsg: We recommend recording a continuous video showing you opening the package for the first time. Without this video, Selene will not be able to process claims for physical damage or missing parts.
detail.WaitingReturnBuyerMsg: Your money is protected by the Selene Shield. We are waiting for the seller to provide the return shipping label. If they don't do so within 48 hours, you will automatically receive your refund and the case will be closed.
detail.WaitingReturnSellerMsg: You have 48 hours to pay for the return shipping label if you wish to recover your hardware. If payment is not received within this timeframe, the system will issue a final refund to the buyer, and you will forfeit your right to claim the product.
detail.deliverySuccessMsg: The package has arrived. Your funds will be released automatically within 48 hours if there are no reports.

prepare.title: Prepare Shipment
prepare.subtitle: Prepare your shipment.
prepare.disclaimer: By generating the shipping label, you confirm that your product is ready and packaged.
prepare.successMsg: The delivery truck knows you're on your way. Print your shipping label and attach it to the package.
prepare.shareLabelMsg: Share your shipping label so others can download it if they don't already have it.
prepare.step1: Download and print the complete guide (3 pages).
prepare.step2: Attach the first page to your box with clear tape around the edges (without covering the code).
prepare.step3: Keep the other two pages and take your package to the Paquete Express branch. Provide the other two pages if requested.
prepare.evidenceSubtitle: Upload 3 photos to protect your sale against potential claims.

dispute.triageSubtitle: Most problems are resolved by checking these points:
dispute.checkPSU: My power supply is sufficient for this component.
dispute.checkCables: I already tried different cables and ports.
dispute.checkPhysical: The damage is internal/technical (not caused by a fall).
dispute.evidenceSubtitle: Upload at least 2 photos showing the problem.
dispute.successMsg: Selene is reviewing your case. Payment to the seller has been frozen until further notice.
